dootsabha_design.reason: DootSabha is not available in this cloud environment; the operator directed that all design/implementation review be done with parallel adversarial agents instead.
dootsabha_design.substitute_evidence: Four adversarial agents on disjoint surfaces (escape-sequence space; terminal state + cross-boundary leaks; render paths + rich TUIs; cost, memory and test quality), each required to drive the real shux binary rather than reason from source, plus the shux-vt-solid-qa gate agent. Gate findings and their disposition are tabulated in SOLID-QA.md.

dootsabha_implementation.reason: Same. The implementation-diff review is carried by the gate agent's independent re-run (it re-derived all 10 original mutations plus one of its own design) and by the adversarial agents.
dootsabha_implementation.substitute_evidence: 12 mutations of the shipped fix, 12 killed by named tests — table in SOLID-QA.md. Two tests that initially passed vacuously were found and strengthened.
